audit_access_boundary.public_run_boundary: The audited B0 run itself is the recorded public fixed-control fit/validation run; this audit did not repeat that run.
audit_access_boundary.state_files_opened: safe_open metadata/header and shape inspection plus full-file SHA-256; no state tensor values loaded into the audit.

audit_scope: CPU-only immutable B0 receipt/schedule/state audit; raw receipt and watchdog evidence are preserved as separate byte-hashed files.

detail.coordinate_definition: global_record is batch_record_indices[step,draw_record_slot]; postBOS_position is raw sequence column 1..191 (BOS column 0 excluded), and zero_based_postBOS_offset=postBOS_position-1.
detail.mask_read_scope: attention_mask only from public B0 payload; activations, token_ids, position_ids, H, model, source text, and truth were not read by this audit.
detail.record_batch_exposure_definition: one (training_step, global_record) exposure per batch slot; every step has 8 distinct records.
detail.support_definition: distinct public fitting-bank token IDs from published coverage_mix_v1; separate from sampled record-position-pair support.
